name: calc_bond_price
description:
Price of a fixed-coupon bond with semi-annual coupons, discounted at a flat yield: sum of coupon/(1+y/2)^i plus face/(1+y/2)^(2n). Computed locally in Python; no API key or network.
Returns {face_value, coupon_rate, yield, price}, price rounded to 2 decimals.
Inputs (* required): face_value (amount; default 1000), coupon_rate* (annual percent), yield_rate* (annual percent), years* (integer years to maturity).
For curve-based pricing with accrued interest and risk measures use qlrisk_price_treasury_bond or qlrisk_price_corporate_bond.
Example: {"face_value": 1000, "coupon_rate": 5, "yield_rate": 4.5, "years": 10}
